messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant):

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger numbers; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; one of the busiest west coast hubs. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the oldest major hubs; key connecting point for domestic and international flights. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Large hub for American Airlines; extensive cargo operations. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN | Known for its distinctive peaked roof; major hub for United Airlines and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK | Primary gateway to Europe and other international destinations. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Major hub for United Airlines; strong focus on transpacific routes. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA | Key hub for flights to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; important for southeastern U.S. connectivity. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high volume of domestic traffic. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | ORL | Major tourist destination; hub for carriers like JetBlue and Spirit. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; close proximity to NYC. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit, MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; significant cargo operations. |

These airports serve as primary gateways for both domestic and international travel and are often hubs for major airlines.
